job_post_detail.title: 服务运营专员（Operations Specialist）-汽车
job_post_detail.description:
1、Data Reporting & Analysis: Responsible for collecting, cleaning, and consolidating daily, weekly, and monthly operational data for the department. Assist in generating data visualization charts for decision-making reference.
2、Reconciliation & Expense Settlement: Assist in processing freight reconciliation with logistics carriers and third-party service providers, including invoice verification and reimbursement filing processes, ensuring accurate and transparent accounts.
3、System & Master Data Maintenance: Assist in maintaining basic master data for supply chain/delivery-related systems (ERP/TMS/WMS), ensuring system data accuracy.
4、Administrative & Process Support: Assist in organizing departmental SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) documents, track key project milestones, and provide daily administrative and logistical support.
job_post_detail.requirement:
1、Education: 2026/2027 fresh graduate, Bachelor's degree or above. Preferred majors include Statistics, Data Analytics, Logistics Management, Financial Management, E-commerce, or related fields.
2、Core Skills: Proficient in Excel (familiar with Pivot Tables, common functions; VBA or Power BI/Tableau experience preferred). Good typing and document writing skills.
3、General Competencies:
1.Exceptional attention to detail and patience with a strong commitment to data accuracy
2.Excellent learning ability, able to quickly adapt to various supply chain software and internal systems
3.Strong team collaboration spirit with good problem-tracking and follow-through awareness
